 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Dissapear"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "Disappear". (गायब होना)

 
 
• **Example: **The magician made the rabbit **disappear** from the hat.
 
 
 
• **"Disappear" **means to cease to be visible or to stop existing. (गायब होना)
 
 
• **Example: **The sun will** disappear** behind the clouds.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Entrepreneur **(उद्यमी): A person who sets up a business or businesses, taking on financial risks in the hope of profit.

 
 
• **Example:** She is a successful **entrepreneur **who started her own tech company.
 
 
 
• **Supersede **(अधिग्रहण करना): To take the place of (a person or thing previously in authority or use); supplant.
 
 
• **Example: **The new regulations will** supersede** the old ones.
 
 
 
• **Vicinity** (आसपास का क्षेत्र): The area near or surrounding a particular place.
 
 
• **Example:** There are several restaurants in the **vicinity** of the office.
